Our vision is to give finance teams, and the agents that support them, one reconciled and explainable presentation of financial truth. Today, the data and context required to make accounting decisions are fragmented across billing systems, contracts, spreadsheets, general ledgers, and the minds of the people doing the work. Finance teams spend significant time reconstructing what happened, determining the appropriate accounting treatment, reconciling results, and gathering evidence. Giving an agent access to the underlying data is not enough: it also needs the business context, accounting policies, approved judgments, and guardrails required to act reliably. Revenue Recognition is our first major proof point. Stripe has a unique opportunity to help Billing and Metronome users turn complex revenue activity—including usage-based pricing, minimum commitments, credits, and contract modifications—into accurate, explainable journal entries. Our ambition is for agents to take on the investigation, configuration, and repetitive work while accountants retain control over consequential judgments and approvals. jobs.description_text: About our organization The Developer Experience & Product Platform (DEeP) organization empowers all of Stripe's products with a shared product platform that delivers high-quality, consistent, cross-product experiences across our UI and API surfaces. DEeP focuses on providing a scalable developer experience that any developer can leverage to accelerate a customer's ability to create value from Stripe. Within DEeP, the Extensibility program is how Stripe expands its total addressable market, and increases customer retention. With extensibility, Stripe becomes programmable — customers and product teams can adapt Stripe to their needs on a common platform. Stripe has three interconnected extensibility primitives: Scripts — Secure, isolated TypeScript runtime allowing merchants and developers to customize Stripe product behavior (e.g., discount calculations, invoice logic, proration). Custom Objects — User-defined data models (e.g., Shipments, Locations, Warranties, Entitlements) with first-class APIs, SDKs, and Dashboard experiences. Workflows — A programmable orchestration layer (graduating to GA at Sessions) enabling no-code and pro-code business logic across Stripe, including custom actions, delays, smart retries, and 3P integrations. These primitives are deeply interdependent, involve 10+ cross-functional teams and culminate in a flagship product launch. jobs.title: AI Engineer - 11952
jobs.description_text: The Impact of an AI Engineer at Coupa: We are seeking a hands-on Agentic AI Developer / AI Engineer to design, build, test and deploy agentic AI solutions leveraging Google Cloud's AI ecosystem. This role is a core part of our AI Delivery "Build" team, responsible for translating business challenges into production-ready AI agents and solutions using Google ADK (Agent Developer Kit), Vertex AI, and related Google Cloud services that create measurable business value. This position combines deep technical expertise with practical execution on Google's AI platform, ensuring that our agentic AI solutions are well-designed, robustly built, and successfully deployed. The Agentic AI Developer will partner closely with business stakeholders, QA Specialists, and Cloud Engineers to build, test, and scale responsible AI solutions from concept to production within the Google Cloud environment. In a forward deployed role, You will embed directly with the portfolio teams whose problems you are solving, work in their tools and their meetings, and deliver agentic and automation solutions in the flow of work: inside the systems people already use every day, not as one more application they have to learn.

jobs.title: AI-Native Functional Consultants Lead
jobs.description_text: Rossum Solution Delivery is standing up AI-Native Services Delivery as a formal operating model inside Coupa Value Services. We are hiring the leader of its functional-consulting layer — a Senior Manager seat reporting to the RVP Solution Delivery, leading a team of seven senior functional consultants who deliver the Rossum-functional side of enterprise customer implementations. The operating model you would join Already shipping, not slideware. Our delivery team runs with agents in the loop — over ninety tools and eighteen production skills in an internal agentic toolchain, built by delivery practitioners for delivery practitioners, on top of Rossum’s own AI engine. We build our own AI. We did not build a business by prompting someone else’s. If that distinction matters to you, this seat will feel like the right place.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer - 11950
jobs.description_text: About the Role We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Core Product Engineering organization within the Integration/ MAT team. In this role, you will focus on building, scaling, and delivering impactful backend features for our core product, with a heavy emphasis on backend system optimization, automation, and expanding our integration capabilities with the wider Coupa ecosystem. Your work is directly connected to Coupa’s unified platform, where we redefine Business Spend Management. You will work closely with our Integrations team to design and evolve high-performing API layers . This is a highly autonomous role where you will tackle complex scalability challenges, write clean, robust code, and actively mentor other engineers to raise technical standards across the team.

jobs.title: Manager, Technical Support
jobs.description_text: The Impact of a Manager, Technical Support at Coupa: As a Manager of Technical Support, you will play a critical role in driving customer satisfaction and scaling our global operations. You will directly oversee critical escalations, optimize queue workflows, and align regional performance metrics with global KPIs to ensure our customers unlock maximum value from Coupa’s AI-driven platform. Acting as a vital bridge, you will collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to translate frontline feedback into product improvements and lead initiatives that modernize our support methodologies. Beyond operational excellence, you will be a champion of talent development and company culture. In alignment with our career progression initiatives, you will mentor, coach, and guide our Support Engineers to foster deep platform expertise and clear career growth. By cultivating a high-performance, inclusive environment and aligning daily workflows with our customer-centric mission, you will inspire your team to innovate and "Build Tomorrow Together." The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location within the state.

jobs.title: Partner Business Director - 11956
jobs.description_text: Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins. Why join Coupa? Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend. Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence. Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other. Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa. The Impact of a Partner Business Director at Coupa: OTE range EUR 143 000-161 667 with a mix of 70/30 The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

jobs.title: Product Management Director, Supplier Network (AI-Powered)- 11969
jobs.description_text: The Impact of a Product Management Director, Supplier Network (AI-Powered) at Coupa: Coupa is scaling one of the world’s largest B2B supplier networks, connecting millions of buyers and suppliers globally through community-generated AI and trillions of dollars in direct and indirect spend data. This role sits at the heart of Coupa’s next phase of growth. You will directly shape the future of the Coupa Network by leading AI-forward innovation that scales supplier success, buyer trust, intelligent automation, and monetization into a durable, two-sided marketplace strategy. Join our fast-paced Supplier Network team that is building the future of the Coupa Network. As a senior product leader, you will own the vision, strategy, and execution for AI-powered features that transform how buyers and suppliers discover, connect, transact, and build trust at scale—driving measurable network liquidity, revenue growth, and platform differentiation in the spend management ecosystem.

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Support Engineer – Intake and Orchestration - 11929

You will troubleshoot technical issues, guide customers on best practices, and work closely with senior teammates and Engineering to find solutions. You will also be the voice of the customer for our Product and Engineering teams. This is a hands-on, fast-paced role, and you will start with a structured onboarding and training program to build your confidence with the platform and our support processes.

jobs.description_text: TECHNOLOGY The Technology team builds end-to-end products and solutions that power our marketplace, delivering an incredible experience for customers globally. THE ROLE We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Data Scientist to join our Data team at FARFETCH, with a focus on evolving our in-house Experimentation Platform and its custom-built Statistical Engine.
